############################################################
# 04_individual_gene_plot.R
#
# Purpose:
#   Plot TMM-normalized expression of a selected gene using
#   the edgeR object generated in the previous scripts.
#
# Input:
#   dge_fil.rds from 01_data_QC.R
#
# Output:
#   Individual gene expression plot
############################################################


# ==========================================================
# 1. USER SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

# CHANGE THIS to your own project directory
project_dir <- "YOUR/PROJECT/DIRECTORY/HERE"

# edgeR object generated during QC
dge_file <- "dge_fil.rds"

# Gene to plot
gene <- "Wdtc1"

# Metadata column to compare
group_column <- "Condition"

# Expression scale:
#   "logCPM" = TMM-normalized log2 CPM (recommended)
#   "CPM"    = TMM-normalized CPM
expression_scale <- "logCPM"

# Plot title
# Leave as gene name, or change manually if desired
plot_title <- gene

# Optional manual colors
use_manual_colors <- TRUE

manual_colors <- c(
  "CTL" = "lightblue",
  "ES"  = "midnightblue"
)

# Output folder
output_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Results",
  "Individual_gene_plots"
)


# ==========================================================
# 2. LOAD PACKAGES
# ==========================================================

library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)


# ==========================================================
# 3. LOAD edgeR OBJECT
# ==========================================================

dge_path <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  dge_file
)

if (!file.exists(dge_path)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "dge_fil.rds not found:\n",
      dge_path
    )
  )
}

dge_fil <- readRDS(
  dge_path
)


# ==========================================================
# 4. CHECK GENE AND GROUPING VARIABLE
# ==========================================================

if (!(gene %in% rownames(dge_fil$counts))) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Gene '",
      gene,
      "' was not found in the edgeR object."
    )
  )
}


if (!(group_column %in% colnames(dge_fil$samples))) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Grouping variable '",
      group_column,
      "' was not found in dge_fil$samples."
    )
  )
}


# ==========================================================
# 5. EXTRACT TMM-NORMALIZED EXPRESSION
# ==========================================================

if (expression_scale == "logCPM") {

  expression_values <- cpm(
    dge_fil,
    log = TRUE
  )[gene, ]

  y_label <- "TMM-normalized log2 CPM"

} else if (expression_scale == "CPM") {

  expression_values <- cpm(
    dge_fil,
    log = FALSE
  )[gene, ]

  y_label <- "TMM-normalized CPM"

} else {

  stop(
    "expression_scale must be either 'logCPM' or 'CPM'."
  )
}


plot_data <- data.frame(
  Group = dge_fil$samples[[group_column]],
  Expression = as.numeric(expression_values)
)


# ==========================================================
# 6. CUSTOM THEME
# ==========================================================

custom_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )


# ==========================================================
# 7. CREATE VIOLIN PLOT
# ==========================================================

p <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = Expression,
    color = Group
  )
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    width = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  custom_theme +
  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    x = group_column,
    y = y_label
  )


# Apply manual colors if requested
if (use_manual_colors) {

  p <- p +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = manual_colors
    )
}


# Display plot
print(p)


# ==========================================================
# 8. SAVE PLOT
# ==========================================================

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


output_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  paste0(
    "individual_gene_",
    gene,
    "_",
    expression_scale,
    ".png"
  )
)


ggsave(
  filename = output_file,
  plot = p,
  device = "png",
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)


message(
  "Plot saved to:\n",
  output_file
)
